list.title: Workspace
list.description: A Workspace is the platform's resource boundary: one Workspace per team or project, each with its own exclusive GPU quota. Dev instances, training jobs, and inference services all run inside your own Workspace.

intro.title: About Workspaces
intro.resourceBoundary: Resource boundary: an independent GPU / CPU / memory quota assigned by platform admins. Tasks in a Workspace share this quota, and Workspaces do not affect each other by default.
intro.permissionBoundary: Permission boundary: only Workspace members can see its dev instances, training jobs, inference services, and templates. There are two roles: member (manages only their own tasks) and Workspace admin (manages all tasks in the Workspace, edits resource templates, and adjusts task priority).
intro.assetBoundary: Asset boundary: resource templates are maintained per Workspace and are independent across Workspaces. FSx / S3 mount points for tasks are also isolated per Workspace.
intro.k8sMappingHint: A Workspace maps to a set of K8s / Kueue objects, all provisioned together by the AWS HyperPod team API on creation.
intro.k8sNamespace: 1 Namespace: named . All Pods / CRs / Services of the Workspace's tasks live here.
intro.k8sResourceQuota: 1 ResourceQuota: the native K8s quota that rejects over-limit requests (a hard wall).
intro.k8sKueue: 1 Kueue ClusterQueue + LocalQueue: task queueing, admission, and preemption all rely on it. The preemption switch (spec.preemption.withinClusterQueue) also acts at this level.
intro.k8sComputeQuota: 1 AWS ComputeQuota (Team): equivalent to the nominalQuota of the Kueue ClusterQueue, synced automatically by AWS. The lend/borrow policy (DontLend / Lend / LendAndBorrow) is configured at this level.
intro.k8sIamRole: 1 IAM Role: all Pods in the Workspace bind to this Role through Pod Identity to access S3 / FSx / SageMaker, and so on.
intro.summary: 💡 In short: a Workspace is roughly a bundle of a K8s namespace + a Kueue ClusterQueue + an IAM Role. Deleting a Workspace cascades to all of these objects (including the tasks inside) and cannot be undone.

fsx.intro: FSx for Lustre file systems mounted to the Workspace. You can mount subdirectories from multiple teams; members must be granted access (read-only or read-write) before they can mount them on dev instances.
fsx.firstMountBlocked: The first FSx mount must be done by a platform admin (it sets this team's gid baseline).

primaryGid.label: Team primary group (gid) =
primaryGid.tooltip: The primary group represents this team's identity: dev instances and tasks run as this identity by default, which determines the FSx directories they can read and write. Mounting another team's shared directory grants extra access to that directory, but the primary identity does not change.
primaryGid.unset: This Workspace has no primary group (gid) yet. Mount your own team's directory first.
primaryGid.unsetTooltip: The primary group represents this team's identity: dev instances and tasks run as this identity by default, which determines the FSx directories they can read and write. The group that owns the first mounted directory becomes the team's primary gid and never changes afterwards, so mount your own team's directory first.

removeConfirm.title: Remove this mount?
removeConfirm.description: This deletes the K8s PV/PVC and related grants, but not the FSx file system itself.

addModal.title: Add FSx mount
addModal.hint: Select an existing FSx file system. The backend detects the directory gid and creates the PV/PVC automatically (one rw set and one ro set).
addModal.noCandidates: No FSx available. Contact an admin.
addModal.mountIdTooltip: Unique among FSx mounts in the Workspace. PVC name = pvc-ws-fsx-{mount ID}-{rw|ro}. Used as the mount path in the Pod by default (/fsx/{mount ID}).
addModal.mountIdPattern: Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, digits, and - only; 3-40 characters
addModal.topDirTooltip: Choose a team directory under /fsx. Cross-team sharing: you can choose another team's directory; the backend detects the real gid.
addModal.topDirPlaceholder: Select an FSx first to list directories
addModal.topDirEmpty: No subdirectories in this FSx. Run mkdir on a node first.
addModal.subPathTooltip: A deeper path under the top-level directory, such as train/proj-b. Final mount = /fsx/<top-level directory>/<subpath>. The gid is detected from the final directory (it may differ from the top-level directory).
addModal.subPathPattern: Letters, digits, _, and - only; separate levels with /; do not start or end with /
addModal.subPathPlaceholder: e.g. train/project-b (leave empty to mount the top-level directory itself)
addModal.mountPathTooltip: Defaults to /fsx/<mount ID> and follows the mount ID. You can change it to any path that starts with /.
addModal.mountPathRequired: Enter a mount path in the Pod
addModal.mountPathPattern: Start with /; letters, digits, _ and - only
addModal.descriptionTooltip: A one-line note on what this mount is for. It is only displayed to other users, with no functional effect. Chinese characters are supported.
addModal.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. ImageNet dataset shared by team-a

grant.title: Grant access to members
grant.hint: Members can mount this directory when creating a dev instance only after being granted access. Read-only = not writable in the Pod (enforced at the kernel level by PV mountOptions:[ro]); read-write = readable and writable.
grant.memberPlaceholder: Select Workspace members (multiple allowed, granted together)
grant.allGranted: All members have been granted access (or the Workspace has no members).
grant.empty: No members have been granted access yet

s3.intro: S3 buckets mounted to the Workspace. Read-write by default, but Mountpoint for S3 does not support rename, random writes, or writes after fsync. Use the boto3 SDK to write checkpoints.

removeConfirm.title: Remove this mount?
removeConfirm.description: This deletes the K8s PV/PVC but not the S3 bucket.

addModal.title: Add S3 mount
addModal.hint: Select an S3 bucket created by the platform. The backend creates the PV and PVC automatically.
addModal.noCandidates: No S3 buckets available. Contact an admin.
addModal.mountIdTooltip: Unique among S3 mounts in the Workspace. PVC name = pvc-ws-s3-{mount ID}. Example: imagenet
addModal.mountIdPattern: Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, digits, and - only; 3-40 characters
addModal.prefixTooltip: Mounts only the objects under this prefix. Leave empty to mount the whole bucket. Example: datasets/imagenet/
addModal.mountPathTooltip: Must start with /; only letters, digits, -, and _ are allowed. Example: /s3/imagenet
addModal.mountPathPattern: Start with /; only letters, digits, -, and _ are allowed
addModal.descriptionTooltip: A one-line note on what this mount is for. It is only displayed to other users, with no functional effect. Chinese characters are supported.

members.intro: Members of this Workspace. Admins can add or remove members and adjust queue priority; regular members can submit tasks and create dev instances.
